html:<strong>⟦0⟧. Cashflowet bliver stra: ⟦0⟧. Cashflow gets tighter. The same rent now has to cover a higher mortgage payment. Deals with thin margins turn into losses.
html:<strong>⟦0⟧. Gældsdækningen (DSCR): ⟦0⟧. Debt service coverage (DSCR) falls. The bank looks at whether the operation can carry the loan. When the mortgage payment rises, DSCR falls — and if it drops below ⟦1⟧, the rent no longer covers the loan. Read more about the term in our glossary.
html:<strong>⟦0⟧. Prisforventningerne sk: ⟦0⟧. Price expectations shift. Higher financing costs put a damper on how much buyers are willing to pay — even in a market where house prices are still expected to rise ⟦1⟧-⟦2⟧ % in ⟦3⟧.
html:<strong>Forhandl på prisen eller ud: Negotiate on price or down payment. A lower price or a larger down payment reduces the loan and restores debt service coverage.
html:<strong>Kig på afkastet, ikke kun v: Look at the yield, not just the price appreciation. In a rate-heavy market, a healthy ongoing yield is what keeps you safe. Our guide to cash flow on Danish property and the various investment strategies will help you prioritise.
html:<strong>Overvej fast rente.</strong: Consider a fixed rate. The Danish central bank has warned that homeowners with the shortest rate periods are most exposed to sudden increases. A fixed rate costs a bit more now, but removes the uncertainty.

html:Den bedste måde at forholde sig til: The best way to deal with rising rates isn't to guess — it's to calculate. html:Efter to år med medvind fra faldend: After two years of tailwind from falling interest rates, the picture has turned.
